title: Stability for the adjoint Finner inequality and improved lower bounds on the $k$-plane transform
summary: We establish stability properties of near-extremisers for the Loomis--Whitney inequality and its adjoint, presenting our results in the general framework of Finner. In particular, we show that a function nearly achieves equality in the adjoint Finner inequality if and only if it is near to being an indicator function of a cartesian product. As an application, we obtain new lower bounds for the classical $k$-plane transform on $L^p(\mathbb{R}^d)$, modestly improving those obtained recently by Tao and the first author.
